stories.title: Jensen Huang Says He Would Return as Nvidia CEO if Asked
stories.summary: Jensen Huang, who recently resigned as Nvidia's CEO due to personal conduct revelations, has stated he would be willing to return to his position if asked. His resignation followed disclosures about affairs with an employee and a woman reportedly connected to Chinese intelligence.

stories.title: Microsoft Takes On OpenAI And Anthropic With 7 New AI Models: Check What They Can Do
stories.summary: Microsoft has introduced seven new AI models designed for various applications, including coding, cybersecurity, image generation, audio transcription, and decision-making. These new tools aim to compete with existing AI offerings from companies like OpenAI and Anthropic, with details provided on their performance and pricing.

stories.title: Introducing GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
stories.summary: New AI models, GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, have been introduced, offering improved professional outputs, coding capabilities, computer use, and efficiency. These advancements are available at a lower cost across ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the API.

stories.title: Apple Maps Gets New Features In India: 3D Landmarks, Better Navigation And More
stories.summary: Apple Maps has received a significant update in India, introducing new features such as over 300 3D landmarks, Look Around functionality, and augmented reality walking directions. The update also includes enhanced navigation, dual-language labels, and support for public transportation.

stories.title: 29 Keynotes, 600 Participants, 30 Plus Countries: Bennett University's 3rd Global AI Summit Begins Tomorrow
stories.summary: Bennett University is set to host its 3rd Global AI Summit, which will feature 29 keynotes and attract 600 participants from over 30 countries. The summit, running from November 18 to 20, will focus on the development of indigenous AI tools specifically for India and the Global South.

stories.title: Nvidia rules out Jensen Huang’s return as CEO, tells investors ‘we’ve got this’
stories.summary: Nvidia has informed investors that its current leadership is stable and that CEO Jensen Huang will not be returning to the position.

stories.title: Nvidia Q3 Results FY27: Revenue More Than Doubles To $115.8 Billion, Forecasts $130 Billion For Q4
stories.summary: Nvidia's revenue more than doubled in the third quarter of fiscal year 2027, reaching $115.8 billion, driven by high demand for AI technologies. The company also projected strong revenue for the upcoming quarter, expecting $130 billion.

stories.title: Anthropic goes public this week. Is its business built to last? | CNN Business
stories.summary: Anthropic is scheduled to go public this week, raising questions about the long-term viability of its business model.

stories.title: Sensex Opens At 82,514, Nifty Below 25,400 As Markets Begin In Red; Oil At $92
stories.summary: Indian stock markets, including the Sensex and Nifty, opened lower due to a strong US dollar, a global sell-off in technology stocks, and declining commodity prices. Oil prices were at $92 a barrel.

stories.title: Chinese steel imports threaten Indian industry, Tata Steel CEO warns
stories.summary: The CEO of Tata Steel, T V Narendran, expressed concerns that Chinese steel imports pose a threat to India's domestic steel industry. Indian steel producers are engaging with the government to discuss protective measures for local production, as Tata Steel plans to significantly increase its own capacity by 2035.

stories.title: Democrats Claim 56 Senate Seats After Mary Peltola Wins in Alaska
stories.summary: Mary Peltola won a Senate seat in Alaska, defeating the incumbent Dan S. Sullivan. This victory marks the first time a Democrat has represented the conservative state in the Senate since 2015, increasing the number of Democratic Senate seats to 56.

stories.title: Trump–Xi–Putin summit: Towards a great-power cartel?
stories.summary: The headline reports on a potential summit involving Trump, Xi, and Putin, raising questions about the formation of a great-power cartel.

stories.title: House Democrats Cast Wide Net as They Prepare Trump Investigations
stories.summary: House Democrats are preparing to launch broad investigations into former President Trump, his family, and key administration officials. These inquiries will also examine Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and policies concerning Nvidia.

stories.title: 'Sitting on disaster': Rahul Gandhi flags India's economic 'crisis' during US visit; BJP hits back
stories.summary: The headline reports that Rahul Gandhi has highlighted an economic 'crisis' in India during his visit to the US, drawing a response from the BJP party.

stories.title: 'Maharashtra Will Never Forgive You': Shinde Sena Tears Pages From Sonia Gandhi's Book
stories.summary: The headline reports that the Shinde Sena faction has criticized Sonia Gandhi, stating that Maharashtra will not forgive her.

stories.title: Federal Judge Blocks Trump’s 2026 F-1 Student Visa Restrictions: What International Students Need to Know
stories.summary: A federal judge has blocked restrictions on F-1 student visas that were set to take effect in 2026. This decision is important for international students as it impacts their ability to study in the United States.

stories.title: DHS Proposes $70,000 Fee for International Students' Training
stories.summary: The Department of Homeland Security has proposed a new fee of $70,000 for international students seeking training opportunities. This proposal could significantly increase the cost for international students pursuing practical training in the U.S.

stories.title: US H-1B Visa Green Card Update: New USCIS, Tighter Sponsorship Rules Proposed; What Indian Professionals, Graduates Need to Know
stories.summary: New proposals from USCIS suggest tighter sponsorship rules for the H-1B visa, which could affect Indian professionals and graduates. These changes are part of an update to the H-1B visa green card process.

stories.title: US work visa: H-1B, 26 other categories can now get 15-day premium processing. What applicants need to know
stories.summary: Premium processing, which allows for a 15-day turnaround, is now available for H-1B visas and 26 other work visa categories. This change offers a faster option for applicants seeking various types of U.S. work visas.

stories.title: US court blocks Trump's CPT restrictions; Indian students could regain access to internships under F-1 vi
stories.summary: A U.S. court has blocked restrictions on Curricular Practical Training (CPT), which could allow Indian students to regain access to internships under their F-1 visas. This ruling impacts the ability of international students to participate in practical training experiences.
